name: levix
description: LEVIX storefront + API (bundled server.js serves the API and frontend/dist)

scripts.postinstall: prisma generate && (prisma db push --skip-generate || echo "⚠️ prisma db push skipped — run 'npm run db:push' manually")
scripts.build: echo "LEVIX is prebuilt: server.js and frontend/dist are committed - nothing to build."
scripts.build:all: npm --prefix backend run bundle && npm --prefix frontend run build
